about: The hub's two hatches stand shut while nobody passes through them (the cast lays nobody yet).

still.hatch_leaf_1: Nobody passes through it: the hub's cast lays nobody until the people have bodies fit to show (#5), and a pressure hatch swinging open and shut with no one there read as a grey board sweeping across the lit doorway (the world 1 film diagnosis, M3, 2026-10-18). It stands shut; it swings again, as people pass through, once the cast lays somebody.
